items.title: Oil's Sudden Price Drop Surprises Citi's Chronert
items.summary: Citi Head of US Equity Strategy Scott Chronert says the sudden drop in oil prices on Wednesday surprised him. Brent fell almost 9% then rebounded on Thursday. He says that took some pressure off of the inflation backdrop.

items.title: Morgan Stanley Sinks 6%, Goldman Down 6%, Citi Down 5% as Market Selloff Drags Wall Street Banks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley fell 6% today, with Goldman Sachs and Citigroup down about as much, in a broad selloff with no company news behind it. Morgan Stanley leans on trading far more than JPMorgan Chase, which leaves it among the banks most exposed if trading and dealmaking cool.

items.title: Dutch Bros earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Dutch Bros Inc (BROS) beat on Q3 EPS and revenue, yet the stock is down about 22%. It traded at $34.33 as of Nov 5, 1:15 PM EST, near its 52-week low of $33.98. The reason is the guidance and traffic outlook, not the quarter itself.

items.title: Nintendo profit misses as Switch 2 sales slump; Citi sees temporary dip
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nintendo reported July-September operating profit below expectations as sales of its Switch 2 console fell sharply, though Citi expects any share price weakness to be temporary.
